scope: Read-only readiness audit; no new solver run or qualification

embedding.limit: This is a check of configured/relevant provisioned locations, not a claim to have inventoried every filesystem path; the converted format would also require a separately authorized experiment.

1a.target: Qualified stored answers for known complete statements and paraphrases; no runtime source generation
1a.existing_evidence: Historical v2: 13/20 correct known, zero wrong/unqualified accepted, 4/4 absent rejected; gate failed. All 3288 old exact paths completed, 2456 approved answers and 832 abstentions.
1a.current_candidate: Changed serving sources are not requalified; no new numerical result
1a.next_user_facing_measurement: After source-bound asset restoration and isolation qualification, rerun exact answer paths; encoder not needed for exact matches. Then evaluate candidate comparison on permitted paraphrase development data with the hash-verified encoder.
1a.minimum_owner_action: Provide the recognition development bundle from an accessible backup or provisioned local path and an approved isolated-judge session; provide original encoder for paraphrase work. No 128 connection is required if a backup exists.
1a.confirmation_eligibility: Not eligible. Freeze a development-qualified candidate and a fresh independently authored/reviewed set before any later confirmation; old v1/v2 openings remain development only.

1b.target: Same recognition engine; one initial description, one stored answer or abstention, zero questions
1b.existing_gate: Correct requirement-equivalent identity, approved stored source, initially supplied public checks, query-owned independent scoring after the decision, abstention on unresolved requirements, zero questions; freeze before reserved descriptions. No numeric final coverage/completion threshold is declared in description_oneshot_v1.json.
1b.existing_evidence: Authored development baseline: target first on 10/16 specified descriptions, top five on 16/16, zero accepted answers. Historical assisted dialogue is not one-shot evidence.
1b.minimum_owner_action: Same restored recognition bundle, verified encoder and approved judge as 1a. Before any future confirmation, agree a numeric first-attempt correctness/coverage criterion without changing existing zero-question, identity or safety requirements.
1b.next_user_facing_measurement: Measure returned, independently correct stored answers and wrong acceptances on permitted initial-description development requests. Requests without sufficient initially supplied public checking must still abstain.
1b.confirmation_eligibility: Not eligible; original 12 complete and four ambiguous reserved cases remain unopened.

2a.target: Autonomous typed graph composition for familiar problems; no hand steering or autoregressive source generation at request time
2a.existing_evidence: Historical fixed checkpoint: 4/10 fit correct, 0/8 audit correct; no current matched comparison or qualified candidate.
2a.minimum_owner_action: Provide the original model.pt and qualified pairs.jsonl plus corresponding non-protected development test files and the hash-verified encoder; provide an approved isolated-judge session.
2a.next_user_facing_measurement: Run the original matched raw/constrained/nearest-fit-graph DEVELOPMENT comparison once prerequisites pass, retaining every prediction, verdict and end-to-end cost. This selects only the correction, not goal completion.
2a.confirmation_eligibility: Not eligible. Required unguided and retrieval-guided search baselines, explicit corrected-route addendum and complete candidate seal remain open. The historical fixed reservation stays 66 entries; no protected scoring this turn.
2a.final_completion_definition: Existing composition contract requires joint correctness/coverage/latency reporting; it does not define a universal known-problem success percentage. Do not convert a development pass into 100% completion.

2b.target: Autonomous adaptation to freshly authored semantic variants; familiar bases may be allowed, changed requirements and answers unseen
2b.existing_gate: Development-qualified frozen composer plus a separately sealed semantic-variant cohort/evaluator; first-attempt correctness and full latency; no tuning after opening. Preserve the broader 66-problem reservation separately. A numeric final nearby-variant pass threshold is not declared.
2b.existing_evidence: No nearby-variant student result or eligible frozen candidate. Historical teacher qualification is not student solving evidence.
2b.minimum_owner_action: First unblock 2a development. Before later independent scoring, authorize a separate reviewed variant contract and numeric success criterion, then seal it with the qualified composer and an approved judge.
2b.next_user_facing_measurement: Only after the required freeze, score fresh semantic variants once; this turn explicitly does not open them.
2b.confirmation_eligibility: Not eligible; do not author/open protected variants as an implementation shortcut.

common_minimum_unblock: Owner supplies original permitted development assets from an accessible backup/local path and a platform-approved execution session that supports the existing bubblewrap isolation. Do not change host policies or remove inherited restrictions within this task.
why_no_more_code_only_work: No statements/stored code/corpus vectors or compatible encoder are available for recognition; no original checkpoint/corpus/tests are available for the matched composition run; isolated execution is unqualified. More fixture tests cannot establish accepted correct answers or close these gates.

conditional_new_experiment_proposal.claim_limit: New development result only; no old-run reproduction, goal completion or protected generalization claim.
